::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 9th [1888]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 2
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

If you look at the notice at p. 499 of the May no and 599 of the June you will see the fees as to questions fully explained. In fact I do not know what more there is to say about them.[^1]

[Bishop Jenner](people/person_758.qmd) has carefully looked over the [Prayer book Lessons](cmy_books/cmybook_202.qmd) and returned them to me and I am going over them with his criticisms. Half is quite ready if you want it for the printers.

I should much prefer having a sum at once- say[£50 for the first thousand](organizations/other_160.qmd), and then a royalty on what afterwards sold

In the last number of the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) [‘Early Recollections’](other_books/otherbook_1059.qmd) are by 

[Mrs Brougham](people/person_207.qmd)
Castlehaven Rectory,
Castle Townsend
Co Cork

I think you have the others

yours sincerely 
C M Yonge

[The One Grief](other_books/otherbook_1060.qmd) is by
[Miss E Bussell](people/person_232.qmd)
St James’ Parsonage
Dingwall

---

[^1]: These were fees for participating in the preparation for the English Literature part of the Cambridge Local Examination.
